name: chat_history.bytes.small
reason: three turns of prompt, one Bash call and a reply: the per event overhead a short chat pays on open, plus the tail's summary

name: chat_history.bytes.2000_turns
reason: two thousand turns, but a chat opens on its tail and pages the rest in on load earlier, so this stays near the tail's size rather than growing with the conversation

name: chat_history.bytes.5mb_tool_output
reason: one 5 MB tool output: cut_outputs caps it at TOOL_OUTPUT_CAP, so the reply stays near 64 KB rather than carrying the whole body

name: git.spawns.sidebar.cold
reason: a first sidebar load of one worktree container (two worktrees) and one plain repo: 5 for get_config's project probe, 33 for git_branch_sync_many over the three rows it drew, about 11 per row, one of them the recorded base lookup

name: git.spawns.sidebar.warm
reason: the same refresh again with nothing touched: every probe hits the dir mtime and HEAD cache. The batch gets no rows because branchSync.ts only asks about rows it has not drawn, and that rule is not measured here

name: invokes.switch.worktree
reason: a warm switch between two visited worktrees: file tree (fs_read_dir, two fs_read_dir_compact, list_project_files, fs_watch_start), git (git_status, list_branches, git_ahead_behind, git_head_sha, git_branch_sync), get_workspace_settings, list_sessions, rpc_attention, dap_stop_all

name: invokes.switch.tab
reason: a switch between two shell tabs of one worktree: fs_read_dir, two fs_read_dir_compact, list_project_files, get_workspace_settings, list_sessions, rpc_attention
